items.title: 企業如何防止AI代理「做錯事」，專家建議四大治理方向
items.summary: 過去一年，「代理式AI」（Agentic AI）成了科技圈熱門關鍵字。從協助寫程式的自動化助手，到能自主處理郵件、管理檔案，甚至代為執行系統指令的智慧代理，這些工具正快速走進企業日常運作，成為員工桌面與伺服器環境中的新住戶。 當企業急著擁抱效率紅利，新的資安破口也隨之浮現。這些擁有自主行動能力的AI代理究竟握有多少權限？IT與資安部門是否知道員工的電腦裡裝了什麼？一旦AI代理判斷失準、代為執行了不該執行的動作，企業又該如何應對？

items.title: test(ui): sample rail anchor after viewport resize
items.summary: test(ui): sample rail anchor after viewport resize The Details layout fixture introduced in #161674 shrinks the browser window while still comparing sampled coordinates with its 900px anchor. Wait for ResizeObserver delivery and the next frame, then retain the new window's exact track and tick positions during composer growth. Preserve every case, exact equality, hidden-rail cutoff, and restoration check. No product code, sleeps, retries, or tolerance changes. Validation: controlled resize fails before and passes after; 30 pressured runs on four CPUs with two workers; nine full-file cases; typed and boundary lint; UI E2E types; independent P2 review. Owning shard 7/8 passes the rail cases and retains the two baseline dashboard pin failures covered by #168328. Check-changed retains unrelated unused-export failures.

items.title: fix: avoid deferring available linked plugins during updates (#168190)
items.summary: fix: avoid deferring available linked plugins during updates (#168190) ## What Problem This Solves Fixes: `openclaw update` defers Doctor work for an available, explicitly linked plugin until package convergence, although package convergence deliberately skips path installs. ## User Impact Available operator-managed linked plugins can complete their Doctor work in the activation phase instead of needlessly deferring it. Missing or stale packages and unrecorded configuration paths remain deferred. Other reasons for the post-plugin Doctor, including deferred model retirement, are unchanged. ## Why This Change Was Made The existing availability decision now recognizes a present `source: "path"` install as independent of package convergence. It continues to require the existing payload and descriptor checks to pass. Update behavior: candidate-side only; it uses the existing update environment and needs no new marker. No new configuration option, schema, or persisted-state format. ## Evidence - Final focused run: both linked/unrecorded state-migration cases passed. The affected Doctor test typecheck graph passed. - The regression drives Doctor preflight in the update environment with a real installed-plugin index and a plugin state-migration contract. It checks that linked installs migrate retained binding data, while the same unrecorded path keeps its migration obligation and original bytes. - Negative control: the linked-install case fails with the original availability implementation, while the unrecorded-path control passes. - The earlier full preflight suite passed all 13 tests. A later full-file run hit timeouts, an abort, and a lost lease (9 passed, 4 failed); the final focused run is the direct regression proof. - Driver: **released v2026.9.8 (git-source install mode, same as the affected install)** → exact candidate `08189f5bbe8cb82567587a3ed8edbba4e2cee65e`. The real managed-Gateway update succeeded, with the linked plugin's state migration executed exactly once during activation and its data/settings preserved (inline evidence below). - npm-package mode is not exercised by that native run because the local Docker npm cell is blocked by **OrbStack virtiofs**: both this candidate and the exact merge base `bc524d8903002ca70d07f9770b2f993e5e7aec59` fail the installed driver's retained-runtime inode check before candidate post-core work. The [Linux release-check published-upgrade-survivor-2026.9.8 job](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38032945484/job/114159364272) passed on Ubuntu 24.04 and supplies the npm-mode evidence; this is a successful job, not a claim that its entire workflow passed. - Native managed-Gateway replay: control `bbb82fd1e8a` (tree identical to `bc524d89030`) versus combined `47c4c3641b6e` (tree identical to `f14888c058d`, containing this change and #168226). Both use an actual linked plugin and legacy bundled-path install records. Only commit metadata was advanced to avoid the already-current fast path. Both updates finished successfully and returned `/readyz` 200. - Control's activation Doctor deferred the linked plugin with “Package convergence must wait”. Combined's activation Doctor did not defer it; the linked-plugin path and records survived. The focused migration regression above separately verifies retained data bytes. Combined also eliminated bundled-alias write/revert churn; control retained it. - Readiness downtime, summing every last-200 → next-200 interval: control **420.642 s** (one outage); combined **498.144 s** (494.934 s + 3.210 s). The stopped-window activation Doctor step took **75.030 s** versus **90.987 s**. These loaded-host samples do not establish a speedup. Both still ran the post-plugin Doctor for deferred model retirement; that independent trigger is unchanged. - Native artifacts: `runs/do-{ctl,f12}/evidence/legacy-index/{summary.json,update-result.json,readiness.jsonl,downtime-all-intervals.json}`, plus `native-legacy-evidence.json` with config-audit and retirement records. - [Maintainer decision](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168190#issuecomment-6094669695): approve the healthy recorded-path exception while retaining the missing/stale/unrecorded/package-managed deferral. ### Released-driver stateful upgrade The fixture was installed through `plugins install --link` and declared a real Doctor state-migration contract. Its migration renames `legacy-binding.json` to `migrated-binding.json` without changing bytes and appends `1` followed by a newline to a counter. Backup resources use Doctor's supplied state directory, so candidate validation runs on the cloned state, not live state. Sanitized `update-result.json` / persisted update-ledger excerpts: ```json { "status": "ok", "mode": "git", "before": {"sha": "fc23bc864e4553c2d215e479eeec47b67a0bf943", "version": "2026.9.8"}, "after": {"sha": "08189f5bbe8cb82567587a3ed8edbba4e2cee65e", "version": "2026.9.9"}, "activationDoctor": { "step": "openclaw doctor", "status": "completed", "startedAtMs": 1791628709879, "endedAtMs": 1791628789375, "exitCode": 0 }, "postUpdate.plugins.npm.outcomes": [ {"pluginId": "harness-probe", "status": "skipped", "message": "Skipping \"harness-probe\" (source: path)."} ], "readyzAfter": 200 } ``` Live-state observations after the update: ```text migration-count.txt bytes: 31 0a # exactly "1" + newline migration-count.txt mtime: 2026-10-10T10:39:18.433789Z activation Doctor window: 2026-10-10T10:38:29.879Z–10:39:49.375Z legacy-binding.json exists: false migrated-binding.json: {"binding":"retained","data":"byte-preserved"} + trailing newline plugin settings: {"binding":"settings-retained"} package-convergence deferrals in update result + complete ledger: 0 ``` The counter was written **inside the activation Doctor window**, before post-plugin convergence. The final live counter remains exactly one, including after the later Doctor. Data SHA-256 is over the original/migrated file bytes; settings SHA-256 compares the before/after JSON subtree serialized with the same two-space indentation and trailing newline: | Bytes | Before SHA-256 | After SHA-256 | | --- | --- | --- | | Plugin data | `adbf0252af99cc5ed2cd81923331a1a3f9aa5e0138bf771c9e9ed8981e5049fb` | `adbf0252af99cc5ed2cd81923331a1a3f9aa5e0138bf771c9e9ed8981e5049fb` | | Plugin settings | `d3ba894374d916f631bf16386b64fc1e1b69cee66bf5ff227b039c5693c0c035` | `d3ba894374d916f631bf16386b64fc1e1b69cee66bf5ff227b039c5693c0c035` | Read-only SQLite `diagnostic_events` config-audit rows (timestamps UTC; local paths/process identity omitted): | Timestamp | Origin | Changed paths | | --- | --- | --- | | 09:09:42.462 | plugin-install | `plugins.installs` | | 09:09:57.820 | cli | `plugins.entries.harness-probe.config`, `plugins.installs` | | 10:39:23.947 | doctor | `meta.migrations.webhookListeners`, `plugins.installs`, `wizard` | | 10:40:11.428 | not recorded | `plugins.installs`, `plugins.load.paths[1]`, `[2]`, `[3]` | | 10:40:40.654 | doctor | `plugins.installs`, `plugins.load.paths[1]`, `[2]`, `[3]`, `wizard.lastRunAt`, `wizard.lastRunCommit` | No update-time row changed `plugins.entries.harness-probe.config`. The latter alias add/remove is expected here: this exact candidate contains fix 2 only, not the separate fix in #168226. Deferred model retirement still caused the later Doctor; it did not rerun the plugin migration. Inspectable retained outputs and proof boundary Native update-result excerpts (paths omitted; no output values changed): ```json { "control": { "status": "ok", "postUpdate.plugins.sync.changed": true, "activationDoctor.durationMs": 75030, "activationDoctor.stderr": "Plugin \"harness-probe\" data/settings upgrade is unfinished: Package convergence must wait until the updating parent releases its install records.", "finalReadyz": 200 }, "combined": { "status": "ok", "postUpdate.plugins.sync.changed": false, "activationDoctor.durationMs": 90987, "activationDoctor.packageConvergenceDeferralCount": 0, "finalReadyz": 200 } } ``` Both persisted installed indexes retained `harness-probe` with `source: "path"` and unchanged source/install paths. Both also retained the three bundled path records, including their original `spec` and `installedAt` values. The native probe does not declare a data-migration contract; this run proves the real updater's availability/deferral branch and retained existing state, not execution of a stateful migration. Stateful migration coverage is the focused regression on this exact head: ```text node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/commands/doctor-config-preflight.plugin-deferral.test.ts -t 'package convergence skips it' Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 2 passed | 11 skipped (13) ``` Its linked case invokes the real migration contract and verifies `{"binding":"retained"}` plus a trailing newline in the migrated file; its unrecorded-path control verifies the original bytes remain and no destination exists. Local Docker npm-mode output on both candidate and exact merge-base control (OrbStack virtiofs limitation, not the successful native git-source run above): ```text package-install: exitCode 0 package-update: exitCode 1 reason: unexpected-error Retained runtime entry does not reference its inventoried file: /dist/a2ui-D3SkzOIh.mjs postUpdate: null ``` Maintainer-intent check: no overlapping changes from the maintainers named in the repository review guide were found in the affected files. Merge danger: two-way door; reverting restores the needless deferral. Blast radius is Doctor availability for explicitly recorded path plugins during updates. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

Keep unfinished recovery bound to its original helper. Document the first-hop recovery route for published updaters blocked by historical device IDs. * fix(update): clarify completed receipt recovery checks Avoid shadowing the prior settlement during archival, check external status before the stale-receipt regression, and link the first-hop recovery procedure from update repair guidance.
